name: Großglockner Hochalpenstraße
kurzbeschreibung: One of Europe’s most beautiful alpine roads with **36 hairpin bends** and breathtaking views of Austria’s highest mountain.
beschreibung: The Großglockner High Alpine Road is located in the municipality of Heiligenblut in Tyrol. It connects the federal state of Salzburg with East Tyrol and crosses the Hohe Tauern National Park. The highest point on the route is the Hochtor at 2,504 meters. Along the road, viewing platforms offer stunning views of the Großglockner and the Pasterze glacier. A central viewpoint is the Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Höhe, featuring exhibitions on the national park region. The toll road is typically open from May to October, inviting visitors to experience a breathtaking high-alpine mountain landscape.
oeffnungszeiten: Anfang Mai bis Ende Oktober, täglich 6:00–20:00
